target.title: fix: preserve session labels across stale rollover
target.body:
Closes #101451

AI-assisted

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who add a custom label to a dashboard session in Control UI could lose that label when the same session key later rolls over to a new sessionId during stale daily/idle session lifecycle activity.

## Why This Change Was Made

The implicit rollover path already preserves user-owned model/auth and behavior overrides when an existing entry mints a new sessionId, but label metadata was still only carried by explicit /new and /reset. This change carries the existing label and displayName in that shared rollover path while leaving spawn lineage limited to explicit reset triggers.

## User Impact

Dashboard session labels remain attached to the same session key across automatic sessionId rotation, so users do not have to reapply labels after normal session lifecycle activity.

## Evidence

Before: with the production carryover lines temporarily removed, the new focused regression failed with expected undefined to be "Other" at src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts:1325.

After:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts -t "preserves user labels across dashboard session stale rollover"
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  1 passed | 135 skipped (136)
```

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  136 passed (136)
```

```text
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.test.src.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/test-src.tsbuildinfo
# both exited 0
```
